name: reviewer-autoresearch decide(approved) → coordinator wake-up
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign autoresearch pack terminal handler. Fires when reviewer-autoresearch terminates with decide(action=approved) — the autoresearch category's chain terminal. Spawns a fresh coordinator loop with the terminal reviewer's loop_id so the coordinator can read_loop_result and synthesize a user-facing reply via decide(action=respond_direct). The respond_direct rule (configs/rules/coordinator/03b-respond-direct.json) publishes the reply on the user-response bus.

Mirrors research pack's 07-reviewer-approved-to-coordinator.json exactly — same wake-up shape, scoped to the autoresearch pack.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
The autoresearch chain you dispatched has reached its terminal. Reviewer-autoresearch at loop $entity.instance evaluated the autoresearch artifact and approved it.

Your job now is to deliver the result to the user. You are not classifying or delegating — the chain has already done the work.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result(loop_id=$entity.instance) to read the reviewer's structured verdict. The reviewer's reason summarises the run shape: iterations completed, baseline vs best, improvement percentage. If the reviewer's loop entity carries autoresearch.artifact.path, the structured artifact lives at that path — you may `bash cat $entity.triple.autoresearch.artifact.path` to read the full rollup (journey, kept diffs, open opportunities) if the reviewer's prose is too terse for a user-facing reply.

Iteration 2 — call decide(action="respond_direct", reason="<your synthesised user-facing answer>"). The respond_direct rule publishes your reason on the user-response bus.

Write the reason as plain prose addressing the user directly. The user asked for an optimization run; tell them what happened: did the metric improve, by how much, what the best change was, whether the run plateaued or hit the cap, what's left to try. Don't dump the full journey — pick the substantive headline. 3-6 sentences is usually right.

metadata.mirrors_research_pattern: Same shape as configs/rules/research/07-reviewer-approved-to-coordinator.json — coordinator wake-up with terminal_loop_id, respond_direct + ask_user allowlist, bash for artifact read. Differs only in the wakeup_mode tag (chain_terminal_autoresearch vs chain_terminal_research) and the related_loops thread (autoresearch-run instead of researcher).
